introduction: Follow the artist’s tools into the Siege Master’s shoes, recover three distinct speech pages, bring four exact wine bottles, return the commander’s borrowed book, find the Viscount’s kitchen onion and gather Myrke’s two named hearts. The sergeant’s paid winter-clothing request is guarded; Masha’s cuisine recipe needs repair.
orientation: Discover IceCrag and meet its residents to reveal their requests. Eight story outcomes are separate from two paid services. The sergeant’s coin-and-clothing request is currently unavailable, and Masha’s incomplete cuisine recipe is excluded. Conversation topics provide clues; discovery has its own achievement.

At the front doors, read the plaque and speak the Frostmaiden’s name, Auril. This unlocks the paired doors; open them before travelling north. Another player can already have opened them. The rear route leads toward the Royal Mausoleum, and the guard walk has its own key.

Help the artist with the stonecutter’s hammer and chisel, then take his calf-skin shoes to the Siege Master. These are two independent offerings. Supplied shoes skip the earlier exchange; a past receipt cannot replace shoes you have spent.

The priest’s three speech pages share one visible name. Inspect their writing: the tubby merchant carries page 1, the olive-skinned female guest page 2 and the foyer cleaner page 3. Keep all three different pages loose together.

The raucous guest needs two cheap white bottles and two elven winebottles. Foggy Woods and Undermountain have declared crate sources, but the elven bottle has a world cap of one. Existing or supplied stock matters; do not expect one reset to provide the complete bundle. His timely-delivery promise has no extra tracked deadline.

Masha’s cookbook request asks for food but its current ingredients include a fox pelt, spell parchment and an item that is unavailable. This project needs repair before it can become a quest achievement or daily. His juicy-onion rewards are different from the ordinary kitchen onion the Viscount wants.

The Viscount needs the ordinary kitchen onion. Masha can interrupt attempts to take onions or everything while awake and out of combat. Obtaining that onion, keeping it now and giving it to the Viscount are separate actions; only the accepted offering completes the request.

The commander’s hidden book can come from the Archivist or the deranged man. An identically named book of another kind is not accepted. The Archivist can transform in combat, and the deranged man’s route can end in a holding room or on the distant Rock.

Myrke wants the Captain of the Upper Echelon’s heart and Strife’s heart together. They are two different loaded trophy items, not ordinary carved hearts. Malice’s vapor and the Archivist’s wolves are separate encounters. Supplied exact trophies do not require a recorded personal kill.

The vault uses several different keys. Malice’s golden key, the treasury key, the Captain’s hidden key sheath and its tiny silver key, and the worn notched key serve distinct parts of the route. RUB the court pedestal to return to the front doors, or the throbbing orb in the ice vault to reach the antechamber. These travels are separate from quest completion.

The sergeant’s three-clothing-plus-coin request and the cleaners’ and servants’ coin purchases are currently unavailable. Foreign shopping and epic services also need supported transactions. A story or daily request does not guarantee a fresh item, an accessible recipient, or a replacement for a spent reward.

The banquet, preserved trophy displays, frozen garden, shroud theft and Myrke’s cloak rumours explain the setting. They do not invent accepted rescue, banquet-start, construction or personal-kill objectives. Bodyguards defend NPCs; their action is separate from a player helping that NPC.

contacts.name: a member of the cleaning crew
contacts.description: Cleaners sweep the foyer and halls. Ask about key or job for a guard-walk key lead. The paid key service is currently unavailable; different cleaner placements carry keys or the third speech page.

contacts.name: the ice artist
contacts.description: The artist works beside the ice sculpture in the garden. Ask about tools, hammer or chisel. His exact two-tool offering supplies calf-skin shoes for the Siege Master.

contacts.name: Malice, the half-breed son of Strife,
contacts.description: Malice starts at the garden gazebo. On death he can leave a ghastly black vapor carrying his possessions. Defeating the first form does not prove the final form’s defeat or recovery of its golden key.

contacts.name: Masha the dicer
contacts.description: Masha works in the banquet kitchen. Ask about cookbook for his cuisine project. Its current recipe is incomplete, so it is excluded from achievements and daily quests until repaired. He can interrupt attempts to take kitchen onions.

contacts.name: a Priest of the First Ascension
contacts.description: The priest waits at the clergy’s banquet table. Ask about notes or speech. Recover three differently numbered pages; his attendant may defend him in combat.

contacts.name: a servant
contacts.description: Serving women start in a guest distribution room and can wander through the castle. Ask about milk. The two-cask coin purchase is currently unavailable.

contacts.name: an ice garden attendant
contacts.description: Garden attendants wear brown fur hats. Their public remarks concern the frozen garden; these remarks grant no separate keyword achievement.

contacts.name: Mahdrel the vault guardian
contacts.description: Mahdrel guards the vault approach and wears the tiny silver key for the Captain’s hidden key sheath. His note explains the layered vault security; the key alone does not open every door.

contacts.name: a raucous guest
contacts.description: The raucous guest can wander from the guest distributor. Ask about wine or reward. He needs two white and two elven bottles, not one of each.

contacts.name: a quiet guest of the castle
contacts.description: The olive-skinned female guest wears Speech Notes 2 on her guest-distributor placement. Inspect the paper; its name matches the other two pages.

contacts.name: an off-duty patrol guard
contacts.description: Off-duty patrol guards wear the exact jacket and pants needed by the sergeant. They do not run the artist’s tool offering or provide an achievement for each garment.

contacts.name: a sergeant
contacts.description: The sergeant starts outside on the castle approach with following privates. Ask about cold or freezing for his winter clothing request, or castle for the front-door clue. His item-and-coin request is currently unavailable.

contacts.name: the Commander
contacts.description: The commander sits in his office upstairs. Ask about book or archivist for the missing borrowed book. His treasury clue and Strife lore do not require a new personal kill.

contacts.name: the Viscount
contacts.description: The Viscount works in his upstairs office. Ask about onion or stomach. He accepts the ordinary kitchen onion, not Masha’s juicy reward, and his assistant may defend him.

contacts.name: a treasury guard
contacts.description: Treasury guards protect the vault approach. One declared placement equips its treasury key. The same-named guards do not all carry a copy.

contacts.name: Cision
contacts.description: The embalmer in the preparation room carries the thick black key to a nearby hidden iron chest. That key can break on use. The displayed bodies are scenery, rather than automatic rescue or carving objectives.

contacts.name: the siege master
contacts.description: The Siege Master sits by the massive round table. Ask about shoes or calfskin. His calf-skin shoe request is separate from the artist’s exchange; his attendant may intervene in a fight.

contacts.name: the Archivist
contacts.description: The Archivist starts in the castle archives with the hidden borrowed book and ornate brass key. In combat he can become a gigantic werewolf and turn archive assistants into hunting wolves, carrying their gear across forms.

contacts.name: the Captain of the Upper Echelon
contacts.description: The Captain of the Upper Echelon carries his named bloody heart and the Mausoleum key. This is the captain Myrke wants; the investigating captain and patrol lieutenants are separate creatures.

contacts.name: Strife, Icess of Auril
contacts.description: Strife carries her named bloody heart and starts on a special route into her office. Her office key lies in the ice vault. Finding the court’s old preserved bodies does not supply her trophy.

contacts.name: Myrke the Stalker
contacts.description: Myrke begins in a rare-mobile distribution route, so finding him is uncertain. Ask about revenge or plan for the two-heart request. His shroud warning and cloak rumours point to separate foreign stories.

contacts.name: the Viscount's assistant
contacts.description: The Viscount’s assistant can rescue his employer during combat. This is an NPC defense action, not a player rescue receipt.

contacts.name: the Siege Master's attendant
contacts.description: The Siege Master’s attendant can rescue his employer during combat. The accepted shoe offering remains its own story.

contacts.name: the Ice Priest's attendant
contacts.description: The ice priest’s attendant can rescue his employer during combat. Returning the three speech pages does not require a recorded defeat of that defender.

contacts.name: a deranged looking man
contacts.description: The deranged man may leave his distributor for the Rock in the Lava Tubes area or remain in a holding room. Ask about book. He carries an accepted hidden book but does not own a separate turn-in.

stories.title: The cleaning crew: buy a guard-walk key
stories.summary: The cleaning crew offers the guard-walk key for 1,000 coin-value units and then leaves. This paid access service is currently unavailable. The same key also has equipped sources among the castle cleaners.

steps.text: Complete The cleaning crew: buy a guard-walk key
steps.hint: Only the accepted exact offering records this entry. Questions, carried items, personal kills and access are separate facts. Every declared reward and any recipient departure still need settlement. A daily request does not promise fresh materials or a present recipient.

stories.title: The ice artist: replace his tools

steps.text: Carry the stonecutter’s hammer
steps.hint: Ghore’s troll stonecutters equip one hammer or chisel on separate placements. These are weapons, so remove them from equipment before offering. The clansdwarf in Khildarak lists both tools, but shopping is currently unavailable. Carry the exact items loose; worn or nested items do not count as loose ingredients. Exact supplied items can skip personal recovery.

steps.text: Carry the stonecutter’s chisel
steps.hint: Use the exact stonecutter’s chisel along with the hammer. The garden attendant’s broom or mason’s grout trowel is not a substitute. Carry the exact items loose; worn or nested items do not count as loose ingredients. Exact supplied items can skip personal recovery.

stories.summary: The freezing sergeant wants the brown fur hat, warm fur jacket, warm fur pants and 25,000 coin-value units. He promises a buckskin pack and key pouch, then leaves. This meaningful help request is currently unavailable because the item-and-coin offering is unsupported; it is separate from the banquet’s start.
